character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: Kael escaped his home after discovering his electrical powers were being manipulated by an unknown source. He tracked a signal to an abandoned facility, only to realize he was being lured into a calibration trap. Now, he has uncovered proof that his own origin is tied to the organization currently hunting him.
